column1: # ci-allowed-skips.tsv — skips that are legitimate in CI (policy: CLAUDE.md "Tests", scripts/run-tests.sh).
# With MOTHER_TEST_STRICT_SKIPS=1 (set by .github/workflows/test.yml) a TAP `# skip` for any test not listed here
# fails the shard — so "go missing", "broker build failed" or "socket never appeared" can't hide as a skip.
# Locally, skips stay allowed. Prefer installing the missing tool in the workflow over adding a row.
